title: Minstrel shows and marching bands in his home town
summary: He loved the minstrel shows and parades with bands playing syncopated marches, which he calls jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Yeah. Records did... But I'll tell you, I used to like to watch minstrel shows when they used to come in town. I used to like to watch the parades. They used to have a parade, and the guys would have tall silk hats on with dusters. I don't know if you know about a duster. It's a coat...a gingham coat or something like that, that they would put on to keep the dust off of them riding them horses and... In them days was horse-and-buggy days, you know. And they were (?)ing down the street, parading there. And I used to like to hear the band. The bands played just Jazz. Just Jazz, but marching Jazz. You see, there's a difference in marches. Marches can be jazzy if you want it to be.
Like what they call a quick step and that sort of thing?

I don't know what sort of step they call it, but... You know, I could say [SINGS SOUSA THEME, WITHOUT SYNCOPATION]. Now, the way these guys would say it: [SINGS IT WITH SYNCOPATIONS AND BROKEN RHYTHMS]. It's the same marching tempo, but it's a struttin' tempo. You dig?
Yeah, it's a swingin'... And them bands would play like that. You know, they wouldn't play it just... And I call that Jazz.
Where did you see those bands?
They used to come to our town, minstrel shows, you know... And I used to like to see them.
What was a show like that like? What would there be?
Like various comedians and things. Minstrel shows, you know. And they had a guy called... Mister Something. Oh, what was his name? Mister Bones. All that stuff.
So it was still strictly a minstrel thing.
It was minstrel. It was a minstrel. There was no Jazz them days.
Would there be like things that would stand out? Like, they would have a very good band...
Well, I liked that music. That's the main thing that ...(?)..., yeah.
